//: PROXY TEST build (S01-W1-INTEGRATE). Its ONLY purpose is to make `api/proxy/**` importable from a test, which `tsconfig.test.json` cannot do: that config fixes `rootDir: "src"`, so a test importing `api/proxy/**` fails with `error TS6059: File '.../api/proxy/...' is not under 'rootDir' '.../src'`. Widening THAT config would relocate every emitted test (`dist-test/tests/**` -> `dist-test/src/tests/**`) and break the repo-root computation of the existing suite, so a SEPARATE scope with an INDEPENDENT output directory is used instead.
//isolation: 🔴 `dist-proxy-test/` is disjoint from `dist-test/`: the 224 pre-existing tests keep their exact output layout, and the cases in this scope are additive. Same type environment as the server scope (lib = ES2022, types = [node], NO DOM).
//scripts: Consumed by `npm run test:proxy` only. Use this scope for tests that must import the Node transport shell; tests that only need the pure M12 policy keep building through `tsconfig.test.json`.
